data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the Role

You will own and build the customer-facing layer of our platform: a portfolio of data intelligence products for hospitals, as well as the shared application framework beneath them.

As the senior technical lead for this area, you will operate with high agency—designing how data is queried, cached, and visualized, building API layers over platform services, and working directly with domain experts to translate complex methodology into intuitive, high-impact products.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Product Ownership: Architect, build, and maintain data intelligence applications from database query contracts down to interactive UI components.

  • Framework & API Layer: Build and own the shared application API layer, composing underlying platform services and published data models into stable contracts.

  • Data-Access & Performance Strategy: Design robust caching, materialization, pagination, and streaming patterns to serve complex analytics from cloud data warehouses with low latency and optimized compute cost.

  • Advanced Data Visualization: Build interactive, non-standard visualization interfaces (e.g., hospital performance benchmarking and peer comparison views) and establish reusable patterns for the broader portfolio.

  • AI-Mediated Interfaces: Implement natural language and LLM-driven application surfaces—including retrieval workflows, tool integration, structured outputs, streaming, and evaluation of latency and cost.

  • Technical Leadership: Shape application architecture, set engineering standards, drive testing discipline, and mentor joining engineers.

Qualifications

Core Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • Full-Stack TypeScript: Deep production experience across both client (React / Next.js) and server (Node.js using Fastify, Express, or NestJS).

  • Advanced Data Visualization: Hands-on experience building custom, interactive visualizations (working with scales, layouts, coordinate systems directly using D3.js alongside Visx, ECharts, or Vega-Lite) and choosing appropriate render targets (SVG, Canvas, WebGL).

  • Analytical SQL & Warehouse Caching: Strong analytical SQL skills (window functions, CTEs, multi-level aggregations) and practical experience designing materialization/caching strategies over columnar cloud warehouses.

  • Client-Side State & Data Management: Expertise with client-side caching, request coalescing, streaming, and table virtualization (e.g., TanStack Query, SWR).

  • Architecture & Abstraction: Proven track record of building reusable abstractions—such as shared API layers, component libraries, or design systems—consumed by other engineers.

Nice-to-Haves (What Will Make You Stand Out)

  • LLM & AI Application Engineering: Practical experience integrating LLMs into production workflows (retrieval/RAG, tool calls, streaming, and evaluation metrics).

  • Multi-Tenant Security: Experience implementing robust, enterprise-grade authorization models where strict data segregation and confidentiality are paramount.

  • Production Observability & AWS: Familiarity with running microservices on AWS, with an emphasis on telemetry, logging, CI/CD, and performance monitoring.

Your Profile

  • Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or a related technical field.

  • Experience: 5+ years in full-stack software engineering building data-dense web applications, custom interactive visualizations, and customer-facing products; including a sustained period within one organization seeing a product through build → launch → iteration.

  • Domain Knowledge: Healthcare or benchmarking domain experience is a plus (basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts; familiarity with hospital decision-making, performance reporting, or medical data workflows is especially valuable).

  • Mindset: Strong product-focused and UX-driven mindset, with a proven ability to translate complex analytical data models and methodology into intuitive, high-performance visual interfaces.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, German is a plus.

  • Working Style: Highly structured, user-empathetic, and motivated to collaborate closely with methodology experts, consultants, and cross-functional engineers in an international environment.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

data.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Scoring & Computation Engine (m/f/d)
data.description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

You will build the core engine that powers our rankings and benchmarks for hospitals worldwide: a versioned, fully reproducible computation layer that transforms harmonized metrics into comparable scores.

The focus of this role is algorithmic computation, mathematical correctness, and system reproducibility—web application development is a limited aspect of this system. As the senior technical owner for this area, you will design how scoring definitions, formula trees, category mappings, and peer-group logic are modeled as data and executed deterministically over time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engine Architecture: Design and build the core scoring engine—a typed, versioned computation graph (DAG) executed deterministically with clear boundary contracts.

  • Methodology as Data: Model complex business logic (formula trees, categorical mappings, peer selection, and comparability adjustments) as versioned, declarative data structures.

  • Determinism & Lineage: Own system lineage, versioning, and execution auditability end-to-end, ensuring any score can be recalculated identically at any future date.

  • Internal Tools & API Layer: Build clean, typed services and contracts for our internal methodology workbench and downstream consumer applications.

  • Testing & Quality Discipline: Establish rigorous testing practices (e.g., golden file testing, property-based testing, regression validation) to prevent calculation drift.

  • Technical Ownership: Shape architecture, drive trade-offs between execution speed and cost, set code review standards, and mentor joining engineers.

Qualifications

Core Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • Graph Algorithms & Engine Concepts: Deep expertise in modeling and evaluating expression trees and dependency graphs (e.g., ASTs, DAGs, cycle detection, topological sorting, memoization, and selective recomputation).

  • Advanced Python & Typing Discipline: Mastery of modern Python with strict typing (mypy/pyright), explicit testing discipline, and clean packaging practices.

  • Deterministic System Design: Proven experience building auditable, reproducible systems using immutable execution records, versioned schemas, and explicit data lineage tracking.

  • Declarative Logic & Domain Modeling: Experience treating business logic as versioned data (e.g., typed schemas, expression trees, rules engines, or domain-specific configurations).

  • Typed API & Schema Design: Demonstrated ability to design, version, and operate production backend contracts and schemas for upstream workflow engines and downstream applications.

Nice-to-Haves (What Will Make You Stand Out)

  • Web Frameworks & Orchestration: Production experience with FastAPI (or similar async frameworks) and workflow tools (e.g., Dagster, Prefect, or Airflow).

  • Performance Profiling: Practical experience analyzing execution memory footprints, CPU profiles, or query efficiency against columnar data warehouses.

  • Cloud Infrastructure: Familiarity with deploying, monitoring, and operating containerized calculation microservices on AWS.

Your Profile

  • Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Experience: 5+ years in backend software engineering building computation engines, rules platforms, or complex data-intensive backend systems; including a sustained period within one organization seeing a core system through build → launch → iteration.

  • Domain Knowledge: Healthcare or benchmarking domain experience is a plus (basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts; familiarity with hospital rating systems, medical classification, or complex scoring methodologies is especially valuable).

  • Mindset: Strong analytical and mathematical mindset, with a proven ability to translate complex domain logic and formulas into clean, deterministic software abstractions.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, German is a plus.

  • Working Style: Highly structured, detail-oriented, and motivated to collaborate closely with methodology experts, analysts, and cross-functional engineers in an international environment.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

data.title: Senior Data Engineer & Consultant (all genders) – Microsoft Fabric
data.description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group steht die teccle wave für ganzheitliche Cloud-Lösungen und digitale Transformation im deutschen Mittelstand. Zur Verstärkung unseres eigenständigen siebenköpfigen Data-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Data-&-Analytics-Plattformen auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric, Azure und Power BI, um nachhaltige Mehrwerte für unsere Kund:innen zu schaffen

  • Aufbau skalierbarer Datenarchitekturen, Datenmodelle und Data Pipelines, die eine effiziente Integration, Aufbereitung und Nutzung von Unternehmensdaten ermöglichen

  • Verantwortung für die technische Konzeption und erfolgreiche Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Kundenprojekte – von der Analyse über Workshops bis zur Qualitätssicherung

  • Sicherstellung leistungsfähiger Reporting-, BI- und Self-Service-Analytics-Lösungen, die datengetriebene Entscheidungen auf allen Ebenen unterstützen

  • Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, Stakeholdern und Projektteams, um Projekte effizient, transparent und zielgerichtet zum Erfolg zu führen

  • Einsatz innovativer Technologien wie Azure AI und Microsoft Foundry zur Erweiterung moderner Datenplattformen und AI-gestützter Analytics-Lösungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Data-, Analytics- oder Cloud-Umfeld mit – idealerweise im Consulting oder in kundenorientierten Projektlandschaften – und verfügst über fundiertes Know-how in Microsoft Fabric, Azure, OneLake, Data Lakes und modernen Datenarchitekturen

  • Du entwickelst, betreibst und optimierst skalierbare Cloud Data Platforms, ETL-/ELT-Prozesse und Data Pipelines mit Microsoft Fabric, Python, SQL sowie modernen CI/CD- und Testing-Standards

  • Du besitzt Erfahrung in Data Engineering, Datenmodellierung, Lösungsarchitektur und Systemintegration; Kenntnisse in Power BI, Spark/PySpark, Azure AI, AI Foundry oder komplexen SaaS-Anbindungen sind ein zusätzliches Plus

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und kundenorientiert, kommunizierst sicher mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern und überzeugst im agilen Projektumfeld mit professionellem Auftreten

  • Du interessierst dich für innovative Technologien, moderne AI- und Analytics-Lösungen sowie technische Projektverantwortung; Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wie DP-600, DP-700, AZ-305 oder AI-102 sind willkommen

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

data.title: Data Analyst (m/f/d)
data.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE: where innovation meets sustainability
We are reshaping the global secondary metals industry to accelerate the circular flow of metals. By combining global trading, advanced processing and digital intelligence, we make secondary metals more predictable, transparent and scalable, strengthening industrial supply chains and reducing reliance on primary metal production.
And the impact is significant: recycling aluminium can reduce greenhouse gas emissions by up to 95% compared with primary aluminium production.
And we take it further! Our SmartSorting Hubs combine advanced sorting technology, automation and AI to transform how complex scrap is processed, turning selected mixed streams into better-defined industrial feedstock while improving material quality and traceability.Join us at a defining stage as we bring the $600 billion scrap metals industry into the 21st century and build a new global standard for secondary metals.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst who turns complex operational and business data into clear insights, better decisions, and measurable improvements. You bring strong hands-on experience in data analysis, SQL, visualisation, and working with large and imperfect datasets - and understand how to connect data to real-world processes and business outcomes.
This is an integrated role at the intersection of business, operations, and technology. You’ll work directly with teams to understand their data needs, dig into the details hands-on, and find the right way to answer their questions - whether through SQL, Excel, dashboards, or other tools. You’ll also translate recurring needs into requirements for Engineering and help build stable, automated reporting and analytics over time, particularly across our trading business.
Join our international team and play a key role in shaping innovative solutions for scrap metal processing - using data and technology to build a more efficient and sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • Analytics & Insights: Turn complex business questions into clear, actionable analysis, identifying trends, opportunities, risks, and the key drivers behind business performance. Work directly with the people who have the data need to understand their questions, challenge assumptions, and turn raw data into meaningful insights and decisions.
  • Data Foundations: Build and maintain the data transformations needed to turn raw data into clean, reliable, analysis-ready datasets in the Data Warehouse. Work hands-on with imperfect data, validate its accuracy and meaning, and identify gaps or inconsistencies in how data is captured.
  • Data Modelling: Translate business requirements into well-structured, reusable data models and clearly defined metrics that provide a trusted source of truth for analytics across the organisation.
  • Data Quality: Implement and maintain data quality checks and tests to ensure data is accurate, consistent, complete, and fresh - proactively identifying and resolving issues with relevant stakeholders and working with Engineering to improve how underlying data is captured.
  • Reporting & Self-Service: Build and support dashboards, reports, and analytical datasets that are intuitive, performant, and optimised for internal reporting and self-service analytics. Help turn recurring analytical needs and ad-hoc analysis into stable, scalable, and increasingly automated reporting.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Engineering, and other teams to understand business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate them into meaningful analytical questions and solutions. Communicate effectively across different levels and functions, from discussing detailed data questions with technical teams to presenting clear insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Documentation & Standards: Maintain clear documentation for datasets, transformations, metrics, and data lineage using dbt Docs or similar tools, and contribute to practical standards for SQL, data modelling, testing, and visualisation.
  • Automation & AI: Identify manual or inefficient analytical workflows and improve them through automation, modern data tooling, and AI-assisted analysis - using AI to accelerate data exploration, querying, documentation, and reporting while maintaining a strong understanding of and control over the underlying data.


YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Business Analytics, or a closely related analytical role, with a track record of turning complex business questions and raw data into reliable analysis, actionable insights, and business decisions
  • Strong analytical and statistical thinking, with the ability to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes, define meaningful metrics, challenge assumptions, and work confidently with imperfect or incomplete data
  • Independent, structured, and pragmatic, with a strong sense of ownership. You are equally comfortable working with business stakeholders and engineers, communicate clearly across different levels and functions, and can bridge the gap between business needs and technical solutions. You are also genuinely curious about AI-assisted analytics and modern cloud data workflows, while maintaining full control of and understanding of the underlying data
  • Strong business understanding and analytical curiosity, with the ability to quickly grasp the essentials of a complex, finance-driven business, understand how the underlying processes work, and translate business needs into meaningful analytical questions. Experience with financials, commodity trading, finance analytics, or accounting is a strong advantage
  • Strong SQL skills with experience working with complex datasets, data transformations, joins, aggregations, window functions, and analytical data models
  • Proven experience working with modern Data Warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, or similar, including building and maintaining clean, reliable datasets for analysis and reporting
  • Experience with modern analytics engineering practices and tools such as dbt, including data modelling, automated data quality tests, documentation, and data lineage
  • Strong experience with BI and visualisation tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker, Tableau, Power BI or similar), with a focus on building clear, performant dashboards and enabling self-service analytics


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment


CONTACT

Discover more about METYCLE:

About us | LinkedIn

We look forward to receiving your application. Irene Prinz is happy to answer any questions you may have: +49 152 34 62 72 85.

data.title: Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
data.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment


CONTACT

About us | LinkedIn

We look forward to receiving your application. Irene Prinz is happy to answer any questions you may have: +49 152 34 62 72 85.

data.title: SCADA Engineering Manager (m/f/d) – Utility Scale PV & BESS
data.description:
Overview

As SCADA Engineering Manager, you take technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems for our utility-scale PV and BESS projects. You act as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and external suppliers such as Gantner or meteocontrol — ensuring these systems are correctly specified, integrated, tested and commissioned.

This role combines strong technical understanding with coordination and stakeholder management: you translate between grid operator requirements, customer expectations, supplier solutions and EPC project realities. 
Most importantly, when a plant reaches commissioning, you ensure SCADA, PPC and communication systems work reliably — rather than becoming the project's last unresolved interface.


Your mission

  • Technical ownership of SCADA, monitoring, plant control and communication systems
  • Supplier management — coordinating SCADA/PPC providers (e.g. Gantner, meteocontrol) and holding them accountable for correct specification, integration and delivery
  • Acting as the central technical interface between engineering, project teams, customers, grid operators and suppliers
  • Testing & commissioning oversight for SCADA, PPC and communication systems
  • Engineering & project coordination across the full plant lifecycle


Your profile

  • Degree in electrical engineering, automation engineering, control engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Several years of professional experience in SCADA, industrial automation, power plant control, renewable energy, or grid integration
  • Experience with utility-scale PV, BESS, substations, or other power generation assets highly desirable
  • Good understanding of SCADA architectures, industrial communication networks, and plant control systems
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, OPC UA or comparable
  • Understanding of active power, reactive power, voltage and grid control concepts is an advantage
  • Experience working with grid operators, utilities, or grid compliance requirements highly desirable
  • Proven track record coordinating external technical suppliers and managing complex system interfaces
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and communication systems
  • Confident communicator with engineers, customers, suppliers and grid operators
  • Structured working style and a strong ownership mentality — you drive technical topics until resolved
  • Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites, suppliers or customers
  • Driving licence category B
  • Fluent English; German language skills strongly preferred
  • A responsible, proactive and solution-oriented approach to work, with the ability to apply professional expertise effectively in day-to-day activities
  • A commitment to respectful, trusting collaboration and mutual support within the team


What we offer

 

  • Work in a growing, international company with a start-up mindset

Praktikum Commercial Operations & Account Management

Ab sofort in München.

UNSERE MISSION

Wir wollen die erste Anlaufstelle für den Autowechsel werden. Mit einer Kombination aus Technologie, Medien und tiefem Verständnis für den Automobilsektor haben wir schon jetzt die Art wie Menschen Autos (ver)kaufen, vermarkten und leasen, auf den Kopf gestellt.

Was als einfache Neuwagen-Vergleichsplattform begann, ist heute einer der größten Online-Marktplätze für den Autowechsel in Europa. Im letzten Jahr allein sind wir dabei mit Fahrzeugen, die im Wert von über £3bn über unser Portal gekauft, geleast oder versteigert wurden, um über 50% gewachsen.

2024 haben wir mit der Übernahme von Autovia – der Plattform hinter AutoExpress und dem Evo Magazin – anschließend unsere Reichweite über Nacht verdoppelt. Zusammen zählen wir nun mit fast 10 Mio. Abonnenten und 1,1 Mrd. jährlichen Aufrufen zu den größten YouTube-Kanälen der Welt. Daneben verkaufen wir 1,2 Mio. Kopien unseres Print-Magazins und erreichen jährlich über 350 Mio. Menschen mit unserem Web-Content.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht fertig.

Mit unserer Business Unit "Get Your Car" machen wir den Prozess, das nächste Fahrzeug zu finden, so einfach, smart und transparent wie nie zuvor.

data.title: Technical Product Manager
data.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

 

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

 

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

 

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end—such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading—from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.

 

This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints—not considerations around the edges.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Own a vertical end-to-end — outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering — system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX — and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs — licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place — define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates — build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

     

What you'll need

  • Product leadership — significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation — solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain — experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement — hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have — engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

     

Outcomes

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 
 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

data.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.

 

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

 

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

 

About the Role

We are looking for an Entrepreneur in Residence to help achieve our mission.

 

You will work directly with founders and senior leaders on high-priority initiatives across hiring, market expansion, partnerships, operations, and growth.

 

This role is for highly capable generalists who enjoy solving problems, moving quickly, and taking ownership. We are looking for people who can turn ideas into execution and create meaningful impact from day one.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority projects across hiring, operations, growth, and market expansion.

  • Build relationships with candidates, recruiters, universities, communities, and external partners.

  • Support new market launches and expansion initiatives.

  • Help identify opportunities and solve operational challenges.

  • Represent ActAI at events, communities, and external engagements.

  • Work closely with founders on strategic initiatives.

  • Take ownership of projects from concept through execution.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Ability to operate independently with limited structure.

  • Strong execution skills and bias toward action.

  • High ownership and willingness to take on unfamiliar challenges.

  • Comfortable working across multiple functions and disciplines.

  • Strong alignment with ActAI's mission and ambition.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

 

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

 

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

 

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

 

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.
